newsitem.title: UK: Joint Jo'burg handling a success-CSC KLM AS/BA BAY.
newsitem.headline: Joint Jo'burg handling a success-CSC KLM AS/BA BAY.

text.p: A pilot scheme between Cargo Service Centre and British Airways World Cargo in Johannesburg could lead to the companies working together in other areas of South Africa, CSC said in a statement.

The joint Johannesburg operation was established in January when BA awarded the handler a five-year contract. Initially a pilot project, BA has now indicated that it is aiming to adopt similar concepts elsewhere.
"We are very pleased with the way the Johannesburg operation is running," said BA's Customer Service Co-ordinator, Linda James.

CSC said Johannesburg is one of its fastest growing stations with a dedicated team at BA's purpose-built facility handling freight arriving and departing on its 13 all-passenger and one freighter flight per week.
The handler has also recently expanded into Durban operating an overnight trucking service to and from Johannesburg and has plans to open a station in Cape Town this year.

"By providing a jointly managed operation, both parties are able to ensure that BA's cargo is being handled to the airline's exact specifications and requirements," said CSC's Peter Cross. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
